description: This file is a shell script performing tests related to Git checkout operations, especially focusing on behaviors involving unborn branches, untracked files, index contents, and branch creation.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a provided description.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the given command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files for equality.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository for testing.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
